title: locate
body:
## locate

Report where photographs say they were taken without writing anything: latitude and longitude as exact signed decimal degrees summed from the stored rationals, the altitude with the height reference the file establishes, the recorded datum, and flags where sources disagree, with an optional approximate distance to a point you declare.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Stored precision is a serialisation property, not GPS accuracy; no position is verified, geocoded or converted between datums.
- A legacy altitude reference 0 or 1 is reported as unspecified, not as sea level or ellipsoidal: only an Exif 3.x file (or a GPS-only 2.4 block) establishes the reference, and the edition evidence is published so you can see why.
- compareTo distances are spherical (mean radius 6371008.8 m) and approximate; a recorded datum that differs from the declared one gives no distance.

Native binding: `the same fixed native listing, used to anchor the independent reader of every location source; the typed position, height reference and edition evidence are host logic over typed records`. Output kind: `["text","table"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `media` | The set of photographs and XMP sidecar files to read: either an explicit list of items or one folder. Every item is captured into the run before any native process starts, and every scanned folder entry is listed in manifest.json as included or excluded with a reason, so you can see exactly which files were and were not examined. | `{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","required":true,"minItems":1,"maxItems":512,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"sha256":{"type":"string","minLength":64,"maxLength":64},"sidecar":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096}}}}}},{"type":"object","properties":{"folder":{"type":"object","required":true,"properties":{"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"extensions":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":11,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"enum","values":[".jpg",".jpeg",".xmp",".tif",".tiff",".dng",".png",".webp",".heic",".heif",".avif"]}},"depth":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":2},"maxItems":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":512},"sidecars":{"type":"enum","values":["none","adjacent"]}}}}}]}` | **required** |
| `compareTo` | A point to measure the approximate distance to from every photo position. The distance is spherical and is published only when the recorded datum matches the declared one. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"latitude":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":24,"required":true},"longitude":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":24,"required":true},"datum":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32}}}` | omitted |
